findings.finding: Bellman factorization needs observed/child-history-measurable interim cash flows and duration, or the corresponding conditional sufficiency. Full observable history alone does not cover omitted hidden cash flows correlated with future payoff. Registered examples satisfy the needed condition.

exhaustive uses policy[state], whereas backward uses state and elapsed time. Its documented unique-clock precondition is necessary, not an automatic property of validate. All registered graph families satisfy it.
study.py invokes pair(p,duration) without passing the safe/launch protocol fields. The frozen values equal the builder defaults; future protocol changes must not silently leave defaults unchanged.

Equal terminal payoff/time alone is insufficient for general adaptive-policy process equivalence. The explicit forced-wait pair does preserve timed cashflows, observation timing, and opportunities, as independently reconstructed for both root choices.

disposition: PASS_REGISTERED_SEMANTIC_RESULT; clarify conditional sufficiency before any broader Bellman claim; no new RL advantage
